passages.title: Train Station Passenger Guide
paras: Platform changes are shown on electronic information boards. Passengers with bicycles should use the designated carriage area.
A ticket bought online can be reprinted at the ticket desk. The left-luggage office closes at 8 p.m.
Passengers needing boarding assistance should request it at least 24 hours ahead. Eating is not permitted on the designated express service.
Passengers can report lost property through the railway website. The ticket barrier accepts contactless bank cards.

passages.title: Recycling and Waste Collection
passages.intro: Local services, rules and practical arrangements
paras: General household waste is collected every Monday. Cardboard boxes must be flattened before they are placed in the recycling bin.
Household batteries must be taken to a designated drop-off point. Food scraps belong in the green organics bin.
Weather-related collection delays are announced on the council website. Furniture and other large items require a separate collection booking.
Plastic and metal containers should be rinsed before recycling. Hazardous chemicals must never be placed in regular household bins.
